materiality_boundary.description: A release that the rail can recall before settlement is below the boundary.

irreversible_external_effect_above_appro.rationale: A settled duplicate payment cannot be rescinded on the rail.

material_information_barrier_breach.rationale: Retained from the enterprise base profile; no Case B row is classified under it.

materiality_boundary.description: An immaterial technical non-conformance does not enter C* solely because its source is statutory.

material_statutory_prohibition.rationale: A sanctions or record-keeping breach is a statutory prohibition whose materiality does not depend on its frequency.

materiality_boundary.description: An unauthorized act with no external effect is below the boundary.

unauthorized_authority_exercise.rationale: Releasing a payment without a valid permit is the system causing an effect it is not authorized to cause.
